ios.desc:
Got tired of unwanted calls, telemarketers, and scammers spoofing your phone number?

WideProtect blocks spam and scam calls using phone number prefixes and patterns — block up to 1 billion numbers, covering 100 area codes in the USA.

Free to try for 3 days, with a restricted phone number count.

PROTECTION FEATURES
- Block calls by prefix or pattern — stop spoofed numbers, robocalls, and telemarketers before they reach you.
- Pre-configured prefixes for the UK, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Austria, Spain, Switzerland, Chile, and India.
- Add prefixes or patterns for any country, including satellite operators.
- Community-reported spam numbers — benefit from numbers flagged by other WideProtect users.
- One-tap blocking from Phone and Contacts via "Share Contact - Block in WideProtect."

PRIVACY & CONVENIENCE
- No registration, no user data collection — install and use.
- Works completely offline — your number list never leaves your device.
- Family Sharing supported, with a discounted price for the whole household.
- Help screen includes a short video manual.

WideProtect is free to download and try. A subscription or one-time lifetime license is required to continue using the app after the trial.

SETUP
After installing, grant permission to all WideProtect extensions via 'iPhone Settings -> Apps -> Phone -> Call Blocking & Identification.'

IMPORTANT NOTICES
- Don't remove the app from memory while it's updating your blocking list — safe to remove afterward.
- Since iOS 26: if you've called a number yourself, it won't be blocked until you delete that call from 'Phone' -> 'Recent.'
- Blocked calls may be forwarded to voicemail, depending on your mobile operator — contact them for details.
- If WideProtect extensions don't appear in iPhone Settings right away, add your prefix in the app, wait 1-2 minutes, then check Settings again.
- WideProtect is available via auto-renewable subscription or one-time payment. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Account Settings.

FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
Email us at dodatoklab@gmail.com with any questions or issues.

quotes.text:
One hack if you get those robocalls that match your area code. Get a new phone number for an area code you think you’ll never go to and use a smart blocking app[1] to block the entire area code.

It’s a brutalist solution that’s not for everyone, but it has restored my sanity.

[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wideprotect-spam-call-blocker/id1171024059
quotes.story_title: FCC finally starts tackling America's robocall scourge

quotes.text:
If you’re on iOS, I highly recommend WideProtect [1] which allows you to define filters matching a range of numbers based on prefix. For example, you can block all numbers from a specific area code that you receive a lot of spam calls from. It has been an absolute lifesaver for me.

[1]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wideprotect-spam-call-blocker/id1171024059

You may be looking for ‘WideProtect Spam Call Blocker’:

For iOS:  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wideprotect-spam-call-blocker/id1171024059

If only one or a few prefixes need match, use Hiya below.  If you want all wildcard prefixes, you want WideProtect.

Most do not support the wildcard formula, this does.

quotes.text:
Be super careful as you do that research - check the Terms of Service.  Some, like Truecaller, are harvesting your call activity and network and reselling it.

It appears Hiya and Nomorobo have sensible policies.

However...

The problem is the completely randomized neighbor calls.

They are “calling from” real numbers belonging to real people.

Hiya Premium has neighbor blocking, but only prefix by prefix, and you can’t bulk add the prefixes.

It appears adding a prefix adds every individual number within that prefix to the phone’s block list, and each call block plugin can only block so many numbers, so the more prefixes you have, the more plugins have to be enabled.

“WideProtect” aims to simplify this, your mileage may vary:

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/wideprotect-spam-call-blocker/id1171024059?mt=8
quotes.story_title: On the Trail of the RoboCall King
